1 Project

2 Levels

Only one level is loaded at a time, so a big game fits in the computer's memory.

How many levels? 10

Moving to the next level: put this block at the end of a level, after the loading cutscene:

console log @next

Or jump to a particular level with @level level4. Search the toolbox for “console log” to find the block.

3 Play together

4 Copying blocks from arcade.makecode.com

The two websites cannot share copied blocks, but they can share code:

1. On arcade.makecode.com, open the JavaScript tab, select the code you want and press Ctrl+C.
2. Here, open the JavaScript tab, click at the very end, press Ctrl+V, then go back to Blocks.
The code turns into blocks for everyone, and the blocks you already had stay where they were.

If your browser allows bookmarks that run code, these do it with blocks directly. Drag them to your bookmarks bar; on arcade.makecode.com, Ctrl+C a block and click Copy for Arcade Collab, then Ctrl+V here.
